name: krivostr
description: Blazing-fast Nostr engine and bridge based on a Haskell core. Has an offline-capable archive, a multiplexing bridge, and a headless CLI and TUI. Built for researchers, bots, and people who follow way too many people.

paragraphs: With krivostr, everything you read lands in a SQLite file you own, indexed for full-text search, and reachable from the command line. Relays forget; your store does not. The name is a portmanteau of Nostr and Krivine, the call-by-name abstract machine that evaluates lambda terms through a stack of closures.
window, indexed on pubkey, createdat, and kind, plus an FTS5 index for search. Read your timeline on a flight; your follows, mutes, and DMs persist.
serve, which answers from the local store and fans out to upstream relays.
features: An offline-capable archive — events in SQLite with a 30-day retention
A multiplexing bridge — the browser speaks ordinary Nostr to krivostr
A headless CLI — twenty-one subcommands over the same store: serve, feed,
Signers at the boundary — NIP-07 browser extension or NIP-46 remote bunker for
A pure core — canonical serialization, signing, verification, and filter matching
